Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 21

“Arjuna said: O Krishna, place my chariot between the two armies, so that I may see those assembled here, eager for battle.”

Arjuna's very first request to Krishna is simple but momentous — he wants to see, clearly and directly, exactly who stands opposed to him. The entire Gita will unfold from this single moment of looking.
